trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts. It performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The claim is: 'H. P. Lovecraft is an author. He is not the author that is famous for writing historical spy novels. The famous author is the one who wrote The Polish Officer (1995).'
trace_summary.final_output_summary: The system completed all three hops and returned 24 documents. Hop 1 retrieved 7 documents using the claim verbatim (none relevant). Hop 2 retrieved 7 documents including 'The Polish Officer' article identifying Alan Furst as the author. Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents including several about H. P. Lovecraft and Lovecraftian topics.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all specified steps successfully. Hop 1 retrieved documents using the claim verbatim but found no relevant information. The summarizer correctly identified the gap. Hop 2's query generator produced a targeted query that successfully retrieved the key document identifying Alan Furst as the author of 'The Polish Officer (1995)'. Hop 3's query generator, working from summaries indicating substantial support had been found, produced a query that retrieved documents about H. P. Lovecraft and related topics. All three hops completed as specified, and the system returned the concatenated 24 documents. The pipeline fulfilled its specification: perform three retrievals and return all retrieved documents without filtering, deduplication, or verdict generation.
